mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 6.0% triggers a weakening labor market, reducing corporate investment and consumer confidence, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 6.0%, or returns revert to positive within the same period.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both general demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signals robust economic growth, leading to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 5 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Correlation between GDPC1 and INDPRO falls below 0.7 over the horizon, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite rising proxies.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion characterized by high general demand (GDPC1) and low unemployment (UNRATE), positive S&P 5 forward returns are anticipated over the next 20 trading days as market participants anticipate sustained growth.
failure_condition: In periods meeting the late-cycle expansion criteria, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing corporate profitability, which drives negative S&P 5 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS crosses above 2.0%, or returns revert to positive within the same period.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both general demand (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) indices reflects broad economic strength, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 5 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Correlation between GDPC1 and HOUST falls below 0.6 over the horizon, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite rising proxies.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the supply index (INDPRO) indicates improving production capacity and lower inflationary pressures, which supports equity valuations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite a sustained rise in INDPRO, or rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPI inflation index (CPIAUCSL) above 110.0% signals accelerating price pressures, leading to market uncertainty and negative S&P 5 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL crosses above 110.0%, or returns revert to positive within the same period.
